Lake Pontchartrain...

waterspouts. This cluster of thunderstorms is generally located along
a line extending from 7 nm southeast of Lake Maurepas to 7 nm north
of Kenner to 7 nm southeast of Lake Pontchartrain/Lake Maurepas,
moving east at 15 knots.

alert in case warnings are issued for waterspout development.
